description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how token routing is distributed across three categories, showing 3 slices in total: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. LOCAL is shown in green and occupies the vast majority of the circle at approximately 94.5%, EDGE_P2P is shown in blue at about 1.6%, and LLM is shown in red at about 3.9%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, and the category names are placed near their corresponding segments without a separate legend. caption_used: Token Routing Distribution in FedHLM: A Dominance of Local Processing with Emerging Edge Dynamics. The pie chart illustrates the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The LOCAL category, represented in green, overwhelmingly dominates the distribution, accounting for approximately 94.5% of the total token routing. The EDGE_P2P category, shown in blue, has stabilized at roughly 5.2%, reflecting a modest but consistent increase in edge-based processing. Meanwhile, the LLM category, depicted in red, has declined to 0.3%, indicating a significant reduction in reliance on large language models. The chart underscores the prevailing preference for local processing while highlighting the growing, albeit still minor, role of peer-to-peer edge routing.
